create_mistral_language_model: create a MistralLanguageModel instance with a model name and API key for text generation
sample_text_mistral: sample text from a Mistral model using a prompt with configurable temperature and max tokens
sample_choice_mistral: sample a multiple choice answer from a Mistral model given a prompt and response options
complete_text_fim: complete fill-in-the-middle text using the Mistral FIM API with a prompt and optional suffix
chat_text_mistral: generate chat completions using the Mistral chat API with system messages and retry logic
